Canva

Turn a brand system into consistent campaign creative.

COfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Canva supports collaborative visual content creation and documented integration capabilities. MoreSpace can build a practical campaign production workflow around approved templates, channel formats, and review responsibilities so marketing assets stay consistent across international markets and repeated launches.

Useful outputs

  • Reusable brand-aligned templates and campaign asset variants
  • Reviewed exports with source design and version references
  • A production calendar and clear creative handoff instructions

Where we can apply it

  • Campaign brief → Canva template → reviewed variants → publishing handoff.
  • Localized offer → approved copy → market-specific creative → final review.
  • Content calendar → eligible design operation → export check → asset library.
01

Use case 1

Create reusable campaign templates with clear brand and channel requirements.

02

Use case 2

Prepare reviewed social, presentation, and landing-page creative variants.

03

Use case 3

Connect eligible template and design operations with a scoped production workflow.

Inputs we need

  • Approved brand assets, typography, and visual usage rules
  • Campaign briefs, audience contexts, and channel dimensions
  • Content owners, localization needs, and creative approval stages

Delivery sequence

  • Translate brand rules and campaign needs into reusable design templates.
  • Create variants for the required channels and test eligible integration operations.
  • Review copy, licensing, localization, and final exports before publishing handoff.

Expert review points

  • Approve claims, translations, and the final asset version before publication.
  • Check template permissions and content rights before automating production.
